basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pathology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur) is filling one Project Technical Support-III post (category UR) on a purely temporary basis under an ICMR/DHR sponsored project on NIPT for sickle cell disorder. The first appointment is for 12 months, with remuneration of ₹28000 + HRA as admissible (consolidated). The essential qualification is a three year graduate degree in a relevant subject / field with three years of post qualification experience, or a PG in a relevant subject / field. Applications go through a Google form and by email to [email p

important_dates.interview_date: Date and time intimated by email

how_to_apply: Fill the Google form at https://forms.gle/1ZEnGj6db6LNsGWt5 on or before 20 November 2026.
Send the scanned copy of the application in the prescribed format (Annexure 1) to [email protected].
Attach the supporting documents with it: degree certificates and experience certificates with CV.
Keep a valid email id and mobile number ready; both are compulsory.
Wait for the email from AIIMS Nagpur: shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, and the date, time and venue are intimated by email only.

Incomplete applications will not be considered. The Annexure 1 application format asks for the applicant's name, parents' names, date of birth, age, gender, marital status, nationality, addresses, contact number, email id, academic record from 10th onwards, work experience, whether currently employed (an NOC may be needed if yes), the time required to join, and the names of two referees. A recent passport photograph is pasted on the form, which carries a declaration with date, place and signature.
Application in the prescribed format (Annexure 1) and bio-data.
Degree certificates and experience certificates with CV (sent by email).
Original certificates and self-attested photocopies of all documents, shown at the interview.
A recent passport photograph on the application form.
important_instructions: The appointee will have to join the duties within 15 days of receiving the appointment letter. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification. Wrong or false information during the process of selection will disqualify the candidature at any stage. The decision of the Principal Investigator will be final. If the candidate is currently employed, an NOC may be needed.

Development and validation of NIPT for sickle cell disorder at tertiary care center in central India-Cross sectional diagnostic accuracy study
Upper age limit 35 years on last date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable: 2 years of experience of working in Molecular Pathology laboratory setting and wet lab of Sanger and NGS assays. The notice adds that qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from an institute of repute, and that experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification. Qualification, experience and other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Project Investigator. The upper age limit is 35 years on the last date of application. It may be relaxed as per Govt. of India rules; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Three year Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + three Years post qualification experience, or PG in relevant subject / field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is ₹ 28000+ HRA as admissible (Consolidated). The consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no other allowances or facilities beyond the consolidated salary will be extended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Fill the Google form at https://forms.gle/1ZEnGj6db6LNsGWt5 on or before 20 November 2026. Send the scanned copy of the application in the prescribed format (Annexure 1) to [email protected] . Attach the supporting documents with it: degree certificates and experience certificates with CV. Keep a valid email id and mobile number ready; both are compulsory. Wait for the email from AIIMS Nagpur: shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, and the date, time and venue are intimated by email only. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The Annexure 1 application format asks for the applicant's name, parents' names, date of birth, age, gender, marital status, nationality, addresses, contact number, email id, academic record from 10th onwards, work experience, whether currently employed (an NOC may be needed if yes), the time required to join, and the names of two referees. A recent passport photograph is pasted on the form, which carries a declaration with date, place and signature. Application in the prescribed format (Annexure 1) and bio-data. Degree certificates and experience certificates with CV (sent by email). Original certificates and self-attested photocopies of all documents, shown at the interview. A recent passport photograph on the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A panel of recommended candidates will be shortlisted after a written test and skill test (if needed), followed by an interview. The panel members may be engaged in present and future vacancies of projects as per requirement from time to time. The validity of the short list is one year from the date of publication of the result. Shortlisted candidates are intimated by email to appear for the written test, skill assessment and interview. The mode of selection is personal interviews or MCQ or skill test or both type. On the day of interview, a written test (MCQ based) with subsequent skill assessment may be conducted for screening. Assessment is conducted in physical mode; the time and venue are communicated by email. The interview is held in the Department of Pathology, Demonstration Room, Second Floor, Medical Laboratory Building, AIIMS, MIHAN, Nagpur - 441108. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test, skill assessment and interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 01 (ONE) post of Project Technical Support-III, in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The Terms & Conditions and the How to apply section ask for applications on or before 20 November 2026. The top of the notice prints 23/11/2026 as the application last date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-III at AIIMS Nagpur?
faq.answer: A three year Graduate degree in relevant subject / field plus three years post qualification experience, or a PG in relevant subject / field. Two years of experience in a Molecular Pathology laboratory setting and wet lab of Sanger and NGS assays is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years on the last date of application. It may be relaxed as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹ 28000+ HRA as admissible (Consolidated). The consolidated salary may vary from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. Are other allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA is mentioned as admissible with the ₹28000 remuneration. The notice says no other allowances or facilities beyond the consolidated salary will be extended.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form and send the scanned Annexure 1 application with degree certificates, experience certificates and CV to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted after a written test and skill test (if needed), followed by an interview. A written MCQ test with skill assessment may be held on the day of the interview for screening.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract basis for an external sponsored project, with a first appointment of 12 months, and no claim to any regular post in AIIMS Nagpur will be entertained.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test, skill assessment and interview.
